title: Efficacy and Safety of a Topical Estradiol Gel for Treatment of Postmenopausal Symptoms
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine the efficacy and safety of a topical estradiol gel for the treatment of hot flushes in postmenopausal women.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Postmenopausal women
* serum estradiol level less than or equal to 20 pg per mL
* serum FSH greater than 40 mIU per mL

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pathological cancer findings on screening
* abnormal endometrium
* serious hepatic, renal or cardiac disease
